_comment: SERVICE_STATUS_MAP: what the automation service does when Switch reports an event.
"pace_job_number" and "customer"). Only events listed here are accepted.
pace_status : Pace status to set (must also be in PACE_ALLOWED_STATUSES, and PACE_ALLOW_WRITE=true)
note        : text for the Pace note that goes with the status change
explain     : true = read the job's preflight report and return CSR + customer write-ups
auto_route  : true = route to the auto-fix branch when every open issue is auto-fixable
Status names below are EXAMPLES: use the exact names from your Pace system.

preflight_failed.note: Preflight found problems that need the customer
